Regulation: B.C. Reg. 141/2026
Made under: Labour Statutes Amendment Act
Published in: No. 14 – B.C. Regs. 125 to 148, July 28, 2026
Deposit date: July 23, 2026

B.C. Reg. 141/2026, deposited July 23, 2026, under theLABOUR STATUTES AMENDMENT ACT, 2026[section 19] andEMPLOYMENT STANDARDS ACT[section 127]. Order in Council 359/2026, approved and ordered July 23, 2026. On the recommendation of the undersigned, the Lieutenant Governor, by and with the advice and consent of the Executive Council, orders that, effective August 1, 2026, (a)	theLabour Statutes Amendment Act, 2026, S.B.C. 2026, c. 10, is brought into force, and (b)	the Employment Standards Regulation, B.C. Reg. 396/95, is amended as set out in the attached Schedule. — J. WHITESIDE,Minister of Labour; A. DIX,Presiding Member of the Executive Council. 1	Section 26 of the Employment Standards Regulation, B.C. Reg. 396/95, is amended by striking out "information is obtained under section 76 (2) of the Act about an employer’s failure    to pay wages or another amount" and substituting "on which information about an employer’s failure to pay wages or another amount    is obtained by the director while conducting an investigation under section 73.1". 2	Section 27 (1) (a) is amended by striking out "section 113 (2)" and substituting "section 112 (2) or 113 (2)". 3	Section 49 (2) is amended by striking out "Sections 112 (2) and (3)" and substituting "Sections 112 (2) to (3.1)". minutes_briefs.title: BC Employment Standards Rules Change for Wage Investigations and Complaints
minutes_briefs.summary: BC Regulation 141/2026, effective August 1, 2026, changes how the Employment Standards Branch handles wage disputes. It updates when the director can act on information about an employer failing to pay wages, now tied to investigations under section 73.1. It also expands references to complaint and determination sections, which may affect how wage complaints are processed and decided.
minutes_briefs.action_required: Review your payroll and record-keeping practices to ensure full compliance with BC Employment Standards Act wage payment rules.
